s00-01-story-d61758.wav.text: If she walked through that door uninvited, she could be put to death.

s00-02-story-4d9d73.wav.text: And her whole people would die if she didn't.

s00-03-talk-03d0ce.wav.text: Here's the strange thing about her story.

s00-05-pivot-a2f057.wav.text: But read it closely, and you'll see him everywhere.

s01-01-story-3cf839.wav.text: Esther was an orphan, a Jewish girl living far from home in Persia.

s01-02-story-bc3782.wav.text: Her cousin Mordecai raised her as his own daughter.

s01-03-story-214008.wav.text: When the king looked for a new queen, he chose Esther.

s01-04-story-c24418.wav.text: But Mordecai told her not to tell anyone she was Jewish.

s02-01-pivot-e4574f.wav.text: Then came Haman, the king's most powerful official.

s02-03-story-d887ea.wav.text: Except Mordecai, who bowed only to God.

s02-04-story-1f9de9.wav.text: Haman was so furious, he decided to destroy not just Mordecai, but every Jew in the empire.

s02-05-story-b5ea1a.wav.text: He threw dice to pick the day.

s02-06-story-4a5e3d.wav.text: And he talked the king into signing the law.

s03-01-pivot-86c0d2.wav.text: Mordecai sent a message to Esther.

s03-02-story-2788c0.wav.text: Go to the king. Beg him to save your people.

s03-03-story-ec4a04.wav.text: But no one could go to the king without being called.

s03-05-story-1264f5.wav.text: Unless he held out his golden sceptre, they would die.

s03-07-grave-960db2.wav.text: And who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

s03-08-story-bc9441.wav.text: Esther asked all the Jews to fast and pray for her for three days.

s03-10-grave-72167e.wav.text: Then I will go to the king, though it is against the law, and if I perish, I perish.

s04-01-pivot-f7d3c8.wav.text: On the third day, she put on her royal robes, and walked in.

s04-02-grave-635324.wav.text: She won favor in his sight, and he held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand.

s04-03-story-955a2a.wav.text: Esther didn't ask for anything yet.

s04-04-story-f18b4a.wav.text: She invited the king and Haman to a banquet.

s05-01-pivot-ae6fa5.wav.text: That night, the king couldn't sleep.

s05-02-story-44ef69.wav.text: So he had the royal records read to him.

s05-03-story-6e9798.wav.text: And he heard how Mordecai had once saved his life, and had never been rewarded.

s05-04-story-304714.wav.text: The next morning, Haman had to lead Mordecai through the city on the king's own horse.

s05-06-story-5aca3a.wav.text: A book opened to the right page. No one says God did it.

s06-01-story-5d7527.wav.text: At the second banquet, Esther told the king the truth.

s06-02-story-2113a5.wav.text: I am Jewish. And this man wants to destroy my people.

s06-03-story-9abf50.wav.text: The king was furious with Haman.

s06-04-story-810b80.wav.text: He gave the Jews the right to defend themselves, and they were saved.

s06-05-grave-9965d5.wav.text: The month that had been turned for them from sorrow into gladness and from mourning into a holiday.

s07-01-talk-0147e9.wav.text: God's name never appears in the book of Esther.

s07-02-talk-25170d.wav.text: But he was there in every turn: an orphan made queen, a night without sleep, a brave woman at a door.
